selectLanguageDescription: Zaɓi yaren da za a yi amfani da shi wajen shigarwa da yaren tsoho na shafin.
verifyRequirementsDescription: Tabbatar cewa yanayin sabar ku yana cika buƙatun gudanar da HAX.
allRequirementsMet: Duk buƙatun sun cika. Zaka iya ci gaba zuwa mataki na gaba.
suggestedCommand: Umarnin da aka ba da shawarar
configureSystemDescription: Saita asusun mai kula da ku don sabon shafin HAX.
adminUsername: Sunan mai amfani na mai gudanarwa
passwordHelp: Bar shi babu komai don samun kalmar sirri mai aminci da aka ƙirƙira ta atomatik, ko shigar da haruffa 10+ tare da aƙalla wasika guda da lamba guda.
installationComplete: An kammala shigarwa! Ga bayanan ku na shiga.
saveCredentialsWarning: Mahimmanci: Ajiye waɗannan bayanan yanzu. Wannan ita ce karo ɗaya tilo da za a nuna su.
languageHelp: Rubuta suna, sunan asali ko lamba.
usernameHelp: Haruffa, lambobi, ɗigo, layi da layin ƙasa.
versionAfterSignIn: Sigar HAXcms da cikakkun hanyoyin sabar suna bayyana a admin na tsarin bayan ka shiga.
foreverTitle: HAX ɗinka naka ne, har abada
foreverFiles: Shafukanka fayiloli ne masu sauƙi a cikin _sites, ana bin diddiginsu da git tun daga rana ta farko.
foreverStandards: An gina shi bisa ƙa'idojin yanar gizo, don haka abin da ka yi zai ci gaba da aiki yayin da HAXcms ke sabuntawa.
foreverPortable: Ɗauki shafi ko'ina: yana aiki a kan HAXcms a PHP ko Node, ko a matsayin fayiloli na tsaye.
foreverPillar: Mai ɗorewa: an gina shi don ya daɗe, mai sauƙi ga duniya.
whileInstallerWorks: yayin da mai shigarwa ke aiki
tvArtCredit: Zanen Future Traveler daga haxtheweb/art. TV yana kama iri ɗaya a haske da duhu.
shortcutFinishedStep: Koma kan matakin da aka gama
padB: B: mayar da tubali na ƙarshe
padNote: HAX Blocks a tasha ta 2: yi tsere da abokan hamayya uku don tubalan HAX. A yana kamawa (ko yana bugun abokin hamayya da ke kusa da kai), B yana mayar da ɗaya, Select yana sake haɗa ɗan wasanka, Start yana wallafawa. Madannanka ma yana aiki: kibiyoyi, A da B suna haskaka maɓallin da suke dannawa.
tipDifferenceTitle: Bambancin HAX: abin da ka yi yana ci gaba da aiki
tipDifference: Shafukanka HTML ne na ƙa'idar yanar gizo a cikin fayiloli masu sauƙi da ka mallaka, ana bin diddiginsu da git. Kusan kowane shafi da aka gina da HAX tun 2020 har yanzu yana aiki a yau, kuma shafi yana motsawa tsakanin HAXcms a PHP, a Node ko masauki na tsaye kamar yadda yake. An gina shi don ya daɗe, mai sauƙi ga duniya.
tipFilesTitle: Kawo fayilolinka ka mai da su HAX
tipFiles: Bayan shigarwa, Shigo a kan dashboard zai mai da su shafin HAX da za ka iya gyarawa, sake haɗawa ka kuma ɗauka ko'ina.
tipSitesTitle: Shigo da gaba ɗaya shafin yanar gizo
tipSites: Nuna Shigo zuwa adireshin shafi kuma shafukansa za su shigo a matsayin shafuka da tubalan HAX.
tipBooksTitle: Littattafai da takardu ma suna shigowa
tipBooks: Buɗaɗɗun littattafan karatu da rumbunan docs-as-code za su zama shafin HAX tare da tsarinsu ba tare da canji ba.
tipPasswordTitle: Kalmar sirrinka tana bayyana sau ɗaya
tipPassword: Mataki na ƙarshe yana nuna sabon bayanan shigarka sau ɗaya kawai. Ajiye shi a mai sarrafa kalmomin sirri kafin ka fara HAXcms.
